quotes.where: §3 (mechanism borrowed: the head compared against something outside)
quotes.text: Closing tail truncation and whole-store rollback requires comparing the store's current head against a "chain_head" or set commitment anchored outside the mutable store (via a SCITT Transparency Service receipt [ RFC9942], an OpenTimestamps calendar proof, or an independent witness log).
